description: Bootstrap the full Laravel 11 project scaffold inside the workspace, install all Composer dependencies, create the shared Blade layout, all CSS/JS shells, all Blade view stubs, .env.example, public/.htaccess for InfinityFree, PWA manifest + service worker stubs, and GitHub Actions FTP deploy workflow. This is the foundation every subsequent FEAT builds on.
steps: Run `composer create-project laravel/laravel .` inside c:\Users\Admin\Desktop\kenya docs to scaffold the full Laravel 11 skeleton (composer.json, artisan, app/, config/, database/, resources/, routes/, public/, bootstrap/, etc.)

Add Composer dependencies to composer.json and run `composer require barryvdh/laravel-dompdf phpoffice/phpword africastalking/africastalking` — these are needed by later FEATs and must be present from the start so autoload works

Create resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php: HTML5 doctype, lang=en, meta charset/viewport, CSS var block (--primary:#1B5E20, --accent:#FF8F00, --bg:#F5F5F5), link to /css/app.css, header with logo + nav, footer, #toast div (for JS notifications), PWA manifest link, @yield('content'), @stack('scripts')

Create public/css/app.css: CSS custom properties reset, flexbox layout, mobile-first responsive grid, button/input/card component styles, toast animation, Kenyan gov-doc aesthetic (green primary, amber accent)

Create public/js/api.js: shared fetch() wrapper that reads the CSRF token from meta tag, sets Content-Type: application/json and X-CSRF-TOKEN header, parses JSON responses, handles 4xx/5xx by showing toast via window.showToast()
Create public/js/home.js, public/js/builder.js, public/js/payment.js, public/js/admin.js as stubs (DOMContentLoaded listeners, empty init functions) — each will be completed in its respective FEAT

Create 14 Blade view stubs extending layouts/app.blade.php: home.blade.php, category.blade.php, builder.blade.php, preview.blade.php, payment.blade.php, download.blade.php, library/index.blade.php, library/show.blade.php, signin.blade.php, my-documents.blade.php, profile.blade.php, admin/dashboard.blade.php, errors/404.blade.php, errors/500.blade.php

Create .env.example with all required keys: APP_NAME, APP_ENV, APP_KEY, APP_DEBUG, APP_URL, DB_CONNECTION=mysql, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_DATABASE, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD, CACHE_DRIVER=file, SESSION_DRIVER=file, QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync, AT_USERNAME, AT_API_KEY, AT_SENDER_ID, PAYHERO_API_KEY, PAYHERO_CHANNEL_ID, PAYHERO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID
Copy .env.example to .env and run `php artisan key:generate --no-interaction`

Create public/manifest.json: name='Kenya Docs', short_name='KenyaDocs', start_url='/', display='standalone', background_color='#F5F5F5', theme_color='#1B5E20', icons array with 192x192 and 512x512 placeholder paths
Create public/sw.js: service worker that precaches ['/','/ css/app.css','/js/api.js'], uses network-first strategy for /api/* routes, cache-first for static assets

Create public/.htaccess: Options -Indexes, mod_rewrite RewriteEngine On, RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f, RewriteRule ^ index.php [L], cache headers for css/js/images (1 year), PHP handler if required by InfinityFree

Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml: trigger on push to main, steps: checkout, setup-php@v4 (8.2), composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader, php artisan optimize, FTP deploy via SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action@latest using secrets FTP_SERVER/FTP_USERNAME/FTP_PASSWORD

Create README.md with project overview, local setup steps, and environment variable table. Create InfinityFree-setup.md with hosting-specific instructions (FTP credentials, MySQL setup, PHP version selection, .htaccess notes)
acceptance_criteria: `php artisan view:cache` exits 0 with no Blade compilation errors
public/manifest.json contains valid JSON (`php -r "json_decode(file_get_contents('public/manifest.json')); echo json_last_error();"`  outputs 0)
findings: PHP 8.2 and Composer are not installed on the development machine (network restrictions blocked winget download). All files were created manually: full Laravel 11 directory scaffold, composer.json with all required dependencies declared, all Blade views, CSS, JS, .env.example, manifest.json, sw.js, .htaccess, deploy.yml, README.md, InfinityFree-setup.md. The `php artisan key:generate` and `php artisan view:cache` acceptance criteria commands require PHP to be installed first; these must be run during CI (GitHub Actions deploy workflow handles this automatically) or after PHP is installed locally. Git repository initialized. APP_KEY in .env is blank — will be populated by `php artisan key:generate` in CI or once PHP is available locally.
